+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build the plumbing review artifacts incrementally from the fixed backup."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import re
+import unicodedata
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+REPORT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = ROOT / "backups/supabase_20260902T153305Z"
+PROPOSAL = REPORT / "plumbing_proposal.jsonl"
+UNRESOLVED = REPORT / "plumbing_unresolved.jsonl"
+
+TARGET_ID = "e083d23e-208f-4dd2-9916-70871a21e113"
+TARGET_CODE = "EXP-14.3"
+
+
+def norm(value: str | None) -> str:
+    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value or "")
+    return " ".join(value.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode().upper().split())
+
+
+def blocked_supplier(supplier: str) -> bool:
+    supplier = norm(supplier)
+    return any(name in supplier for name in (
+        "BANCO BICE", "BANCO DE CHILE", "SANTANDER", "GEA FARM",
+    ))
+
+
+def job_line(item: str) -> bool:
+    return bool(re.search(
+        r"\b(SERVICIO|SERVICIOS|INSTALACION|REPARACION|MANTENCION|PROYECTO|"
+        r"CONSTRUCCION|CAMBIO|TRASLADO|CONFECCION|MANO DE OBRA|ARREGLO|"
+        r"FABRICAR|MANTENCION)\b",
+        item,
+    )) and "KIT INSTALACION FOSA SEPTICA" not in item
+
+
+def proposed_group(row: dict, supplier: str) -> str | None:
+    item = norm(row.get("item_text"))
+    desc = norm(row.get("description"))
+    text = f"{item} | {desc}"
+
+    if blocked_supplier(supplier) or job_line(item):
+        return None
+    if re.search(
+        r"\bGAS\b|NEUMATIC|MOTO\b|MOTOR\b|TRACTOR|VEHIC|INFLADO|LECHE|"
+        r"SERAP|REFRIGER|COMPRESOR|CONDUIT|INYECCION",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return None
+    if "RODILLO TERMOFUSIONADO" in text or "TUBO DE DUCHA ESQUINERO" in text:
+        return None
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"AQUAPLUV|PVC[ -]?SANIT|SANITARIO GRIS|SANIT\.GRIS|PVC-S\b|"
+        r"DESAGUE|SIFON|FOSA SEPTICA|TUBO DRENAJE|Y SANITARIA|CURVA SANITARIA|"
+        r"JUEGO DE FITTING PARA SANITARIO|"
+        r"(?:CANALETA|TUBO BAJADA|ABRAZADERA TUBO BAJADA|TAPA CANALETA|"
+        r"GANCHO FIJAC CANALETA|CODO HEMBRA/HEMBRA).*?(?:P25|VINILIT)",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "building_drainage"
+
+    if re.search(r"\bPPR\b|TERMOFUS|TUBERIA FUSION", text):
+        return "building_ppr"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"FLEXIBLE (?:AGUA|CALEFONT)|KIT LLAVE ANGULAR.*FLEXIBLE|"
+        r"LLAVE (?:ANGULAR|LAVAMANOS|DUCHA)|COMBINACION LAVAPLATOS|GRIFERIA|"
+        r"MONOMANDO (?:DUCHA|LAVAPLATO)|JUEGO DUCHA|SET DUCHA|MANGO DUCHA|"
+        r"RECEPTACULO DUCHA|^LAVAPLATO ",
+        text,
+    ) and "MUEBLE" not in text:
+        return "building_fixture"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"PVC.*PRESION|PRESION.*(?:PVC|VNT)|PVC-H CEM|ADHESIVO PVC|"
+        r"ADHESIVO VINILIT|CEMENTO PVC|\bHDPE\b|\bPEAD\b|"
+        r"CANERIA POLIETILENO|CANERIA COBRE.*AGUA|TUBERIA CLASE .*PRESION|"
+        r"TUBERIA LLDPE|TIRA TUBO COLECTOR|PVC HIDR",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "farm_pipe"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"COLLAR(?:IN| ARRANQUE).*?(?:PVC|POLIPROP)|SALIDA ESTANQUE|"
+        r"FILTRO AGUA|FILTRO MALLA PURIFICACION|MICROTUBO|ASPERSOR|GOTERO|"
+        r"AP TAPON BEBEDEROS",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "farm_water_specific"
+
+    component = (
+        r"(?:BUSHING|NIP+LE|NIPPLE|COPLA|CODO|TEE|UNION|TERMINAL|ADAPTADOR|"
+        r"REDUCCION|TAPON|CURVA|CRUZ|VEE|BUJE)"
+    )
+    context = (
+        r"(?:\bHI\b|\bHE\b|\bSO\b|GALV|PVC|PPR|PLANSA|COMPRESION|\bCEM\b|"
+        r"HILO|PLAST|BRONCE|ALUMINIO|POLIPROP)"
+    )
+    if re.search(component + r".*" + context, text) or re.search(
+        context + r".*" + component, text
+    ):
+        if not re.search(r"MANGUERA|ESPIGA|MARIPOSA", text):
+            return "threaded_fitting"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"^(?:CODO (?:1/2|25MM|90 20MM PRESION|SOLDAR)|"
+        r"COPLA(?:$| 20MM| 25MM| SOLDAR| ROSCADA)|NIPLE PP |"
+        r"ADAPTADOR LLAVE HEMBRA|ADAPTADOR MACHO 3/4 BRO|TEE ROSCADA PN16)",
+        item,
+    ):
+        return "threaded_fitting"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"VALVULA (?:DE )?BOLA|VALVULA (?:BOLA|COMPACTA|COMPTA|COMPRESION|"
+        r"REGULADORA DE PRESION|VENTOSA|RETENCION VERTICAL)|"
+        r"LLAVE (?:DE )?BOLA|LLAVE BOLA JARDIN|LLAVE PASO|FLOTADOR [0-9]|"
+        r"MINI VALVULA ESPIGA-HE",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "valve_tap"
+
+    if re.search(r"\bTEFLON\b", text):
+        return "sealant"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"MANGUERA.*JARDIN|JARDIN.*MANGUERA|MANGUERA.*AGUA|"
+        r"CONECTOR RAPIDO.*REHAU|CONECTOR.*GARDTECH",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "explicit_water_hose"
+
+    return None
+
+
+def unresolved_reason(row: dict, supplier: str) -> str | None:
+    item = norm(row.get("item_text"))
+    desc = norm(row.get("description"))
+    text = f"{item} | {desc}"
+
+    if blocked_supplier(supplier):
+        return None
+    if re.search(r"\bGAS\b|NEUMATIC|MOTO\b|MOTOR\b|TRACTOR|VEHIC|INFLADO|LECHE|SERAP|REFRIGER|CONDUIT|INYECCION|PQS", text):
+        return None
+    if proposed_group(row, supplier):
+        return None
+
+    if re.search(r"MANGUERA|HELIFLEX|CAMLOCK|STORZ|ESPIGA", text):
+        return "Generic hose or hose coupling; the wording does not identify water/plumbing rather than irrigation, machinery, or another system."
+    if re.search(r"\bABRAZ(?:ADERA|\.)", text):
+        return "Generic clamp; the wording does not identify the pipe, hose, machine, or job it was bought for."
+    if re.search(r"(?:CANERIA|TUBERIA) (?:COBRE|L )|^PVC$|TUBO A\.R\.B/P", item):
+        return "A pipe-like material is named, but the wording does not settle water plumbing versus refrigeration, machinery, or construction use."
+    if re.search(r"ACOPLE(?:S| RAPIDO)|CONECTOR RAP |BUSHING NYLON|SELLO ANTIFUGA|TAPON (?:REUSABLE|UNIVERSAL)", text):
+        return "Generic fitting; the wording lacks a named pipe/fluid system, so plumbing use cannot be established from the line alone."
+    if re.search(r"MATERIAL(?:ES)? (?:RED AGUA|DE RIEGO)|REPUESTOS MANTENCION ESTANQUE", text):
+        return "The line says materials/parts for a water-related system but does not name the actual material; proposing it would classify a job bundle, not an evidenced item."
+    if re.search(r"CARTUCHO REPUESTO FILTRO 80 MICRAS|CONTENEDOR DE FILTRO MEDIANO", text):
+        return "A fluid-filter component is named, but the wording does not identify the water, irrigation, milking, or machine system."
+    return None
+
+
+def output_row(row: dict, supplier: str, *, group: str | None = None, reason: str | None = None) -> dict:
+    result = {
+        "item_id": row["item_id"],
+        "item_text": row.get("item_text"),
+        "description": row.get("description"),
+        "supplier": supplier,
+        "amount": row.get("amount"),
+        "current_predicted_code": row.get("predicted_code"),
+    }
+    if group:
+        evidence = row.get("item_text") or row.get("description")
+        result.update({
+            "proposed_code": TARGET_CODE,
+            "proposed_categories_id": TARGET_ID,
+            "evidence": evidence,
+        })
+    else:
+        result["reason"] = reason
+    return result
+
+
+def read_existing(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
+
+
+def append_rows(path: Path, rows: list[dict]) -> None:
+    existing = read_existing(path)
+    seen = {row["item_id"] for row in existing}
+    overlap = seen & {row["item_id"] for row in rows}
+    if overlap:
+        raise SystemExit(f"refusing duplicate append to {path.name}: {len(overlap)} item_ids")
+    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        for row in rows:
+            handle.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--proposal-group")
+    parser.add_argument("--list-group")
+    parser.add_argument("--unresolved", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--list-unresolved", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--summary", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    items = [json.loads(line) for line in (BACKUP / "invoice_items.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
+    invoices = {row["invoice_id"]: row for row in map(json.loads, (BACKUP / "invoices.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())}
+    review = [row for row in items if row.get("decision") != "auto_accept" and row.get("final_categories_id") is None]
+    assert len(review) == 4411
+
+    proposed: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
+    unresolved: list[dict] = []
+    for row in review:
+        supplier = invoices[row["invoice_id"]]["seller_name"]
+        group = proposed_group(row, supplier)
+        if group:
+            proposed.setdefault(group, []).append(output_row(row, supplier, group=group))
+            continue
+        reason = unresolved_reason(row, supplier)
+        if reason:
+            unresolved.append(output_row(row, supplier, reason=reason))
+
+    proposed_ids = {row["item_id"] for rows in proposed.values() for row in rows}
+    unresolved_ids = {row["item_id"] for row in unresolved}
+    assert not proposed_ids & unresolved_ids
+
+    if args.summary:
+        for group, rows in sorted(proposed.items()):
+            print(f"proposal {group:24} {len(rows):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in rows):,}")
+        print(f"proposal TOTAL{'':18} {len(proposed_ids):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for rows in proposed.values() for row in rows):,}")
+        by_reason: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
+        for row in unresolved:
+            by_reason.setdefault(row["reason"], []).append(row)
+        for reason, rows in by_reason.items():
+            print(f"unresolved {len(rows):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in rows):,}  {reason}")
+        print(f"unresolved TOTAL {len(unresolved):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in unresolved):,}")
+
+    if args.list_group:
+        rows = proposed.get(args.list_group)
+        if rows is None:
+            raise SystemExit(f"unknown proposal group {args.list_group!r}; choices: {sorted(proposed)}")
+        for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda row: (norm(row["item_text"]), row["item_id"])):
+            print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
+    if args.list_unresolved:
+        for row in sorted(unresolved, key=lambda row: (row["reason"], norm(row["item_text"]), row["item_id"])):
+            print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+    if args.proposal_group:
+        rows = proposed.get(args.proposal_group)
+        if rows is None:
+            raise SystemExit(f"unknown proposal group {args.proposal_group!r}; choices: {sorted(proposed)}")
+        append_rows(PROPOSAL, sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row["item_id"]))
+        print(f"appended {len(rows)} {args.proposal_group} rows to {PROPOSAL.name}")
+    if args.unresolved:
+        append_rows(UNRESOLVED, sorted(unresolved, key=lambda row: row["item_id"]))
+        print(f"appended {len(unresolved)} rows to {UNRESOLVED.name}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Plumbing proposal — client reply 2026-09-02
+
+## Decisions relied on
+
+- **D-030 — client authority outranks row volume.** Cristian's written answer
+  that building and farm plumbing all go to `EXP-14.3` is the governing label,
+  even where the current model predicts another code.
+- **D-041 — do not resolve an open client question in the payload.** A service,
+  project, place, generic hardware item, or use-ambiguous material stays in
+  review. Construction, bale-making, and the hardware-store default are not
+  inferred here.
+- **D-042 — backing gold `source`, not `prediction_source`, carries authority.**
+  This pass does not use `prediction_source` as evidence. The authority is the
+  client's 2026-09-02 answer recorded above.
+- **D-043 — surface decisions before acting.** This batch report records the
+  load-bearing decisions before the proposal; the non-interactive run does not
+  pause for confirmation.
+- The hard limits remain intact: no row is added to gold, no unaudited row is
+  promoted to gold, and no category is created. `EXP-14.3` already exists as
+  categories_id `e083d23e-208f-4dd2-9916-70871a21e113`.
+

+decision != 'auto_accept' AND final_categories_id IS NULL

+
+The data-first working is preserved in `VOCABULARY.md`. The five highest-volume

+# Plumbing material vocabulary

+## Accepted vocabulary, with the lines that justify it
+
+The accepted vocabulary is deliberately made of material families plus
+context. The example after each entry is an exact line from the review queue.
+
+- Sanitary/drainage PVC: `PVC-SANIT`, `PVC SANITARIO`, `SANITARIO GRIS`,
+  `DESAGUE`, `SIFON`, and `VEE` when paired with sanitary PVC. Evidence:
+  `* MT.X TIRA PVC-SANITARIO GRIS 110MM CERTIFICADA CESM`,
+  `Ñ-TEE REGISTRO 110 PVC-SANITARIO HOFFENS -@`, and
+  `DESAGUE TINA/RECEPTACULO E70 X S1,1/4" 9052642 VINIL`.
+- PPR/thermofusion water pipe and fittings: `PPR`, `TERMOFUSION`, and the
+  `FU-` product family. Evidence: `FU-TUBERIA FUSION 20MM O PPR -@`,
+  `FU-CODO 20MM PPR -@`, and `TUBO TERMOFUSION PN 20 20MM X 6 MT`.
+- Rainwater drainage: `AQUAPLUV`, and `TUBO BAJADA`/`CANALETA` only when the
+  wording identifies the gutter system. Evidence: `AQ-GOMA SELLO AQUAPLUV
+  TIGRE -@`, `AQ-TUBO BAJADA X 3 METROS -ACQ-TIGRE -@`, and
+  `UNION CANALETA ARENA P25- VINILIT`.
+- Pressure-water PVC: `PVC PRESION`, `PVC-H CEM`, and PVC cement/adhesive.
+  Evidence: `TUBO PVC PRESION C/16 20 MM`, `TAPON GORRO PVC-H CEM. 110MM.`,
+  and `ADHESIVO PVC VINILIT C/BROCHA TRADICIONAL 240 CC`.
+- HDPE/polyethylene compression water fittings: `HDPE`, and `COMPRESION` when
+  attached to a named pipe fitting. Evidence: `HDPE-TEE COMPRESION 63MM -@`,
+  `Codo Compresión 32mm Arangül`, and `Válvula Compresión HE 32mm Arangül`.
+- Threaded pipe fittings: `BUSHING`, `NIPLE`/`NIPPLE`, `COPLA`, `CODO`, `TEE`,
+  `UNION`, `TERMINAL`, `ADAPTADOR`, `REDUCCION`, `TAPON`, `CURVA`, and `CRUZ`
+  when the wording includes pipe-thread markers/material (`HI`, `HE`, `SO`,
+  galvanised, plastic, PVC, PPR, PLANSA, compression). Evidence:
+  `-BUSHING REDUCCION HE-HI 1 X 3 4 -@`, `GG-NIPPLE HE-HE GALV 2 1 2 -@`,
+  `TEE GALVANIZADA 3/4"`, and `PL-TERMINAL HE 1 2 PLANSA -@`.
+- Water valves and taps: `VALVULA DE BOLA`, `VALVULA COMPACTA`,
+  `LLAVE BOLA JARDIN`, `LLAVE ANGULAR`, water `LLAVE PASO`, `FLOTADOR`, and
+  `VENTOSA`, except when the line explicitly names gas, a vehicle, a machine,
+  or a milking-system component. Evidence: `VALVULA DE BOLA HI ITALI 1"`,
+  `LLAVE BOLA JARDIN PN16 DE 3 4 X 1 GENEBRE -@`, and
+  `Válvula Ventosa Triple 2" GTR`.
+- Plumbing fixture connections: water/calefont `FLEXIBLE`, `SIFON`, `DESAGUE`,
+  and named taps or sanitary fixtures. Evidence: `FLEXIBLE CALEFONT 1/2HI X
+  1/2HI X 25CM 051033211 TAUM`, `SIFON LAVAPLATOS LOA HOFFENS S/CURVA -@`,
+  and `LLAVE LAVAMANOS 1001 AQUAKIT J1001 UNIDAD -@`.
+- Pipe seal/joining consumables: `TEFLON`, PVC adhesive/cement, and rubber
+  seals only when their wording names the pipe system. Evidence: `TEFLON
+  MAESTRO 3/4"`, `ADHESIVO VINILIT 240CC.SECADO LENTO`, and
+  `AQ-GOMA SELLO AQUAPLUV TIGRE -@`.
+- Tank/pipe take-offs and irrigation fittings that themselves name a plumbing
+  material: `COLLAR ARRANQUE`, `COLLARIN POLIPROPILENO`, `SALIDA ESTANQUE`,
+  water `FILTRO`, and explicitly water/irrigation connectors. Evidence:
+  `COLLAR ARRANQUE PVC P/PVC 63 X 1"`, `SALIDA ESTANQUE CEM 63 X 2 -@`, and
+  `FILTRO AGUA PVC NEGRO 2 PULG. PRAKTUS -@`.
+
+## Candidate words that are not automatic membership
+
+- `MANGUERA`, `HELIFLEX`, `CAMLOCK`, `STORZ`, generic `ESPIGA`, and generic
+  `ABRAZADERA` can belong to irrigation, a milking parlour, compressed air,
+  gas, a vehicle, or a machine. They are unresolved unless the same wording
+  names water/plumbing use.
+- `LLAVE` also names hand tools and keys. Examples rejected by the broad token:
+  `JGO 10 LLAVES ALLEN TRUPER -@`, `LLAVE STILLSON 14 TRUPER 15838 -@`, and
+  `CANDADO ODIS 340 2 LLAVES`.
+- `BOLA` also names tow balls. `BOLA ARRASTRE` is not a valve.
+- `AGUA` also appears in paint (`ESMALTE AL AGUA ...`), so it is not a rule.
+- `PRESION` appears in washers and gas regulators; it requires pipe/valve
+  context.
+- `PVC` appears outside plumbing, and a generic `TUBO` may be structural or
+  electrical. The line must name the plumbing system/material.
+- Generic `FILTRO`, `BOMBA`, `SELLO`, `GOMA`, `EMPAQUETADURA`, and `ANILLO`
+  are not plumbing vocabulary without system context.
+- Gas-specific hose, regulators, and valves are excluded from this proposal:
+  the standing client convention places gas hoses in `EXP-16.2`, and the
+  2026-09-02 answer discussed farm water and building water plumbing.
+- A service, repair, installation, project, property, or other job description
+  is not a material even if it mentions a pipe or valve. Those rows remain in
+  review under the open construction/use question.
+
+This vocabulary is a candidate generator, not the classifier. Every resulting
+row must still be read in full before it enters either JSONL file.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build the plumbing review artifacts incrementally from the fixed backup."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import re
+import unicodedata
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+REPORT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = ROOT / "backups/supabase_20260902T153305Z"
+PROPOSAL = REPORT / "plumbing_proposal.jsonl"
+UNRESOLVED = REPORT / "plumbing_unresolved.jsonl"
+
+TARGET_ID = "e083d23e-208f-4dd2-9916-70871a21e113"
+TARGET_CODE = "EXP-14.3"
+
+
+def norm(value: str | None) -> str:
+    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value or "")
+    return " ".join(value.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode().upper().split())
+
+
+def blocked_supplier(supplier: str) -> bool:
+    supplier = norm(supplier)
+    return any(name in supplier for name in (
+        "BANCO BICE", "BANCO DE CHILE", "SANTANDER", "GEA FARM",
+    ))
+
+
+def job_line(item: str) -> bool:
+    return bool(re.search(
+        r"\b(SERVICIO|SERVICIOS|INSTALACION|REPARACION|MANTENCION|PROYECTO|"
+        r"CONSTRUCCION|CAMBIO|TRASLADO|CONFECCION|MANO DE OBRA|ARREGLO|"
+        r"FABRICAR|MANTENCION)\b",
+        item,
+    )) and "KIT INSTALACION FOSA SEPTICA" not in item
+
+
+def proposed_group(row: dict, supplier: str) -> str | None:
+    item = norm(row.get("item_text"))
+    desc = norm(row.get("description"))
+    text = f"{item} | {desc}"
+
+    if blocked_supplier(supplier) or job_line(item):
+        return None
+    if re.search(
+        r"\bGAS\b|NEUMATIC|MOTO\b|MOTOR\b|TRACTOR|VEHIC|INFLADO|LECHE|"
+        r"SERAP|REFRIGER|COMPRESOR|CONDUIT|INYECCION",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return None
+    if "RODILLO TERMOFUSIONADO" in text or "TUBO DE DUCHA ESQUINERO" in text:
+        return None
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"AQUAPLUV|PVC[ -]?SANIT|SANITARIO GRIS|SANIT\.GRIS|PVC-S\b|"
+        r"DESAGUE|SIFON|FOSA SEPTICA|TUBO DRENAJE|Y SANITARIA|CURVA SANITARIA|"
+        r"JUEGO DE FITTING PARA SANITARIO|"
+        r"(?:CANALETA|TUBO BAJADA|ABRAZADERA TUBO BAJADA|TAPA CANALETA|"
+        r"GANCHO FIJAC CANALETA|CODO HEMBRA/HEMBRA).*?(?:P25|VINILIT)",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "building_drainage"
+
+    if re.search(r"\bPPR\b|TERMOFUS|TUBERIA FUSION", text):
+        return "building_ppr"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"FLEXIBLE (?:AGUA|CALEFONT)|KIT LLAVE ANGULAR.*FLEXIBLE|"
+        r"LLAVE (?:ANGULAR|LAVAMANOS|DUCHA)|COMBINACION LAVAPLATOS|GRIFERIA|"
+        r"MONOMANDO (?:DUCHA|LAVAPLATO)|JUEGO DUCHA|SET DUCHA|MANGO DUCHA|"
+        r"RECEPTACULO DUCHA|^LAVAPLATO ",
+        text,
+    ) and "MUEBLE" not in text:
+        return "building_fixture"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"PVC.*PRESION|PRESION.*(?:PVC|VNT)|PVC-H CEM|ADHESIVO PVC|"
+        r"ADHESIVO VINILIT|CEMENTO PVC|\bHDPE\b|\bPEAD\b|"
+        r"CANERIA POLIETILENO|CANERIA COBRE.*AGUA|TUBERIA CLASE .*PRESION|"
+        r"TUBERIA LLDPE|TIRA TUBO COLECTOR|PVC HIDR",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "farm_pipe"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"COLLAR(?:IN| ARRANQUE).*?(?:PVC|POLIPROP)|SALIDA ESTANQUE|"
+        r"FILTRO AGUA|FILTRO MALLA PURIFICACION|MICROTUBO|ASPERSOR|GOTERO|"
+        r"AP TAPON BEBEDEROS",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "farm_water_specific"
+
+    component = (
+        r"(?:BUSHING|NIP+LE|NIPPLE|COPLA|CODO|TEE|UNION|TERMINAL|ADAPTADOR|"
+        r"REDUCCION|TAPON|CURVA|CRUZ|VEE|BUJE)"
+    )
+    context = (
+        r"(?:\bHI\b|\bHE\b|\bSO\b|GALV|PVC|PPR|PLANSA|COMPRESION|\bCEM\b|"
+        r"HILO|PLAST|BRONCE|ALUMINIO|POLIPROP)"
+    )
+    if re.search(component + r".*" + context, text) or re.search(
+        context + r".*" + component, text
+    ):
+        if not re.search(r"MANGUERA|ESPIGA|MARIPOSA", text):
+            return "threaded_fitting"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"^(?:CODO (?:1/2|25MM|90 20MM PRESION|SOLDAR)|"
+        r"COPLA(?:$| 20MM| 25MM| SOLDAR| ROSCADA)|NIPLE PP |"
+        r"ADAPTADOR LLAVE HEMBRA|ADAPTADOR MACHO 3/4 BRO|TEE ROSCADA PN16)",
+        item,
+    ):
+        return "threaded_fitting"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"VALVULA (?:DE )?BOLA|VALVULA (?:BOLA|COMPACTA|COMPTA|COMPRESION|"
+        r"REGULADORA DE PRESION|VENTOSA|RETENCION VERTICAL)|"
+        r"LLAVE (?:DE )?BOLA|LLAVE BOLA JARDIN|LLAVE PASO|FLOTADOR [0-9]|"
+        r"MINI VALVULA ESPIGA-HE",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "valve_tap"
+
+    if re.search(r"\bTEFLON\b", text):
+        return "sealant"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"MANGUERA.*JARDIN|JARDIN.*MANGUERA|MANGUERA.*AGUA|"
+        r"CONECTOR RAPIDO.*REHAU|CONECTOR.*GARDTECH",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "explicit_water_hose"
+
+    return None
+
+
+def unresolved_reason(row: dict, supplier: str) -> str | None:
+    item = norm(row.get("item_text"))
+    desc = norm(row.get("description"))
+    text = f"{item} | {desc}"
+
+    if blocked_supplier(supplier):
+        return None
+    if re.search(r"\bGAS\b|NEUMATIC|MOTO\b|MOTOR\b|TRACTOR|VEHIC|INFLADO|LECHE|SERAP|REFRIGER|CONDUIT|INYECCION|PQS", text):
+        return None
+    if proposed_group(row, supplier):
+        return None
+
+    if re.search(r"MANGUERA|HELIFLEX|CAMLOCK|STORZ|ESPIGA", text):
+        return "Generic hose or hose coupling; the wording does not identify water/plumbing rather than irrigation, machinery, or another system."
+    if re.search(r"\bABRAZ(?:ADERA|\.)", text):
+        return "Generic clamp; the wording does not identify the pipe, hose, machine, or job it was bought for."
+    if re.search(r"(?:CANERIA|TUBERIA) (?:COBRE|L )|^PVC$|TUBO A\.R\.B/P", item):
+        return "A pipe-like material is named, but the wording does not settle water plumbing versus refrigeration, machinery, or construction use."
+    if re.search(r"ACOPLE(?:S| RAPIDO)|CONECTOR RAP |BUSHING NYLON|SELLO ANTIFUGA|TAPON (?:REUSABLE|UNIVERSAL)", text):
+        return "Generic fitting; the wording lacks a named pipe/fluid system, so plumbing use cannot be established from the line alone."
+    if re.search(r"MATERIAL(?:ES)? (?:RED AGUA|DE RIEGO)|REPUESTOS MANTENCION ESTANQUE", text):
+        return "The line says materials/parts for a water-related system but does not name the actual material; proposing it would classify a job bundle, not an evidenced item."
+    if re.search(r"CARTUCHO REPUESTO FILTRO 80 MICRAS|CONTENEDOR DE FILTRO MEDIANO", text):
+        return "A fluid-filter component is named, but the wording does not identify the water, irrigation, milking, or machine system."
+    return None
+
+
+def output_row(row: dict, supplier: str, *, group: str | None = None, reason: str | None = None) -> dict:
+    result = {
+        "item_id": row["item_id"],
+        "item_text": row.get("item_text"),
+        "description": row.get("description"),
+        "supplier": supplier,
+        "amount": row.get("amount"),
+        "current_predicted_code": row.get("predicted_code"),
+    }
+    if group:
+        evidence = row.get("item_text") or row.get("description")
+        result.update({
+            "proposed_code": TARGET_CODE,
+            "proposed_categories_id": TARGET_ID,
+            "evidence": evidence,
+        })
+    else:
+        result["reason"] = reason
+    return result
+
+
+def read_existing(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
+
+
+def append_rows(path: Path, rows: list[dict]) -> None:
+    existing = read_existing(path)
+    seen = {row["item_id"] for row in existing}
+    overlap = seen & {row["item_id"] for row in rows}
+    if overlap:
+        raise SystemExit(f"refusing duplicate append to {path.name}: {len(overlap)} item_ids")
+    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        for row in rows:
+            handle.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--proposal-group")
+    parser.add_argument("--list-group")
+    parser.add_argument("--unresolved", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--list-unresolved", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--summary", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    items = [json.loads(line) for line in (BACKUP / "invoice_items.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
+    invoices = {row["invoice_id"]: row for row in map(json.loads, (BACKUP / "invoices.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())}
+    review = [row for row in items if row.get("decision") != "auto_accept" and row.get("final_categories_id") is None]
+    assert len(review) == 4411
+
+    proposed: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
+    unresolved: list[dict] = []
+    for row in review:
+        supplier = invoices[row["invoice_id"]]["seller_name"]
+        group = proposed_group(row, supplier)
+        if group:
+            proposed.setdefault(group, []).append(output_row(row, supplier, group=group))
+            continue
+        reason = unresolved_reason(row, supplier)
+        if reason:
+            unresolved.append(output_row(row, supplier, reason=reason))
+
+    proposed_ids = {row["item_id"] for rows in proposed.values() for row in rows}
+    unresolved_ids = {row["item_id"] for row in unresolved}
+    assert not proposed_ids & unresolved_ids
+
+    if args.summary:
+        for group, rows in sorted(proposed.items()):
+            print(f"proposal {group:24} {len(rows):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in rows):,}")
+        print(f"proposal TOTAL{'':18} {len(proposed_ids):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for rows in proposed.values() for row in rows):,}")
+        by_reason: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
+        for row in unresolved:
+            by_reason.setdefault(row["reason"], []).append(row)
+        for reason, rows in by_reason.items():
+            print(f"unresolved {len(rows):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in rows):,}  {reason}")
+        print(f"unresolved TOTAL {len(unresolved):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in unresolved):,}")
+
+    if args.list_group:
+        rows = proposed.get(args.list_group)
+        if rows is None:
+            raise SystemExit(f"unknown proposal group {args.list_group!r}; choices: {sorted(proposed)}")
+        for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda row: (norm(row["item_text"]), row["item_id"])):
+            print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
+    if args.list_unresolved:
+        for row in sorted(unresolved, key=lambda row: (row["reason"], norm(row["item_text"]), row["item_id"])):
+            print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+    if args.proposal_group:
+        rows = proposed.get(args.proposal_group)
+        if rows is None:
+            raise SystemExit(f"unknown proposal group {args.proposal_group!r}; choices: {sorted(proposed)}")
+        append_rows(PROPOSAL, sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row["item_id"]))
+        print(f"appended {len(rows)} {args.proposal_group} rows to {PROPOSAL.name}")
+    if args.unresolved:
+        append_rows(UNRESOLVED, sorted(unresolved, key=lambda row: row["item_id"]))
+        print(f"appended {len(unresolved)} rows to {UNRESOLVED.name}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Plumbing proposal — client reply 2026-09-02
+
+## Decisions relied on
+
+- **D-030 — client authority outranks row volume.** Cristian's written answer
+  that building and farm plumbing all go to `EXP-14.3` is the governing label,
+  even where the current model predicts another code.
+- **D-041 — do not resolve an open client question in the payload.** A service,
+  project, place, generic hardware item, or use-ambiguous material stays in
+  review. Construction, bale-making, and the hardware-store default are not
+  inferred here.
+- **D-042 — backing gold `source`, not `prediction_source`, carries authority.**
+  This pass does not use `prediction_source` as evidence. The authority is the
+  client's 2026-09-02 answer recorded above.
+- **D-043 — surface decisions before acting.** This batch report records the
+  load-bearing decisions before the proposal; the non-interactive run does not
+  pause for confirmation.
+- The hard limits remain intact: no row is added to gold, no unaudited row is
+  promoted to gold, and no category is created. `EXP-14.3` already exists as
+  categories_id `e083d23e-208f-4dd2-9916-70871a21e113`.
+
+## Source and population
+
+All measurements use only
+`backups/supabase_20260902T153305Z/`, taken
+2026-09-02T15:33:05Z. Its manifest reports 11,746 `invoice_items` rows and
+SHA-256 `4c43c93076f3116d81e6c2f707291c2af98ea67ba1d5e761e96a2ef2af276206`.
+The review population is re-derived as:
+
+```text
+decision != 'auto_accept' AND final_categories_id IS NULL
+= 4,411 lines, CLP 949,052,038
+```
+
+Only those 4,411 lines are eligible. Supplier comes from the matching local
+`invoices.jsonl` row. No Supabase connection or other external source is used.
+Bank suppliers (BICE, Banco de Chile, Santander) and GEA are explicitly outside
+this lane and cannot enter the proposal.
+
+## Vocabulary method
+
+The data-first working is preserved in `VOCABULARY.md`. The five highest-volume
+hardware/building-material suppliers contribute 1,463 review lines worth
+CLP 27,400,346. Their most frequent material signals generated candidates; the
+full `item_text` and every populated `description` were then read before a row
+could be proposed.
+
+Hardware-store membership is never an inclusion rule. It is only where the
+vocabulary search began. A hardware row enters this proposal only when its own
+wording names a plumbing material. Conversely, a plumbing material from a
+different supplier remains eligible. This keeps Cristian's two answers apart:
+there is no default for hardware purchases, but a specifically named plumbing
+material has the settled `EXP-14.3` destination.

+## Accepted vocabulary, with the lines that justify it
+
+The accepted vocabulary is deliberately made of material families plus
+context. The example after each entry is an exact line from the review queue.
+
+- Sanitary/drainage PVC: `PVC-SANIT`, `PVC SANITARIO`, `SANITARIO GRIS`,
+  `DESAGUE`, `SIFON`, and `VEE` when paired with sanitary PVC. Evidence:
+  `* MT.X TIRA PVC-SANITARIO GRIS 110MM CERTIFICADA CESM`,
+  `Ñ-TEE REGISTRO 110 PVC-SANITARIO HOFFENS -@`, and
+  `DESAGUE TINA/RECEPTACULO E70 X S1,1/4" 9052642 VINIL`.
+- PPR/thermofusion water pipe and fittings: `PPR`, `TERMOFUSION`, and the
+  `FU-` product family. Evidence: `FU-TUBERIA FUSION 20MM O PPR -@`,
+  `FU-CODO 20MM PPR -@`, and `TUBO TERMOFUSION PN 20 20MM X 6 MT`.
+- Rainwater drainage: `AQUAPLUV`, and `TUBO BAJADA`/`CANALETA` only when the
+  wording identifies the gutter system. Evidence: `AQ-GOMA SELLO AQUAPLUV
+  TIGRE -@`, `AQ-TUBO BAJADA X 3 METROS -ACQ-TIGRE -@`, and
+  `UNION CANALETA ARENA P25- VINILIT`.
+- Pressure-water PVC: `PVC PRESION`, `PVC-H CEM`, and PVC cement/adhesive.
+  Evidence: `TUBO PVC PRESION C/16 20 MM`, `TAPON GORRO PVC-H CEM. 110MM.`,
+  and `ADHESIVO PVC VINILIT C/BROCHA TRADICIONAL 240 CC`.
+- HDPE/polyethylene compression water fittings: `HDPE`, and `COMPRESION` when
+  attached to a named pipe fitting. Evidence: `HDPE-TEE COMPRESION 63MM -@`,
+  `Codo Compresión 32mm Arangül`, and `Válvula Compresión HE 32mm Arangül`.
+- Threaded pipe fittings: `BUSHING`, `NIPLE`/`NIPPLE`, `COPLA`, `CODO`, `TEE`,
+  `UNION`, `TERMINAL`, `ADAPTADOR`, `REDUCCION`, `TAPON`, `CURVA`, and `CRUZ`
+  when the wording includes pipe-thread markers/material (`HI`, `HE`, `SO`,
+  galvanised, plastic, PVC, PPR, PLANSA, compression). Evidence:
+  `-BUSHING REDUCCION HE-HI 1 X 3 4 -@`, `GG-NIPPLE HE-HE GALV 2 1 2 -@`,
+  `TEE GALVANIZADA 3/4"`, and `PL-TERMINAL HE 1 2 PLANSA -@`.
+- Water valves and taps: `VALVULA DE BOLA`, `VALVULA COMPACTA`,
+  `LLAVE BOLA JARDIN`, `LLAVE ANGULAR`, water `LLAVE PASO`, `FLOTADOR`, and
+  `VENTOSA`, except when the line explicitly names gas, a vehicle, a machine,
+  or a milking-system component. Evidence: `VALVULA DE BOLA HI ITALI 1"`,
+  `LLAVE BOLA JARDIN PN16 DE 3 4 X 1 GENEBRE -@`, and
+  `Válvula Ventosa Triple 2" GTR`.
+- Plumbing fixture connections: water/calefont `FLEXIBLE`, `SIFON`, `DESAGUE`,
+  and named taps or sanitary fixtures. Evidence: `FLEXIBLE CALEFONT 1/2HI X
+  1/2HI X 25CM 051033211 TAUM`, `SIFON LAVAPLATOS LOA HOFFENS S/CURVA -@`,
+  and `LLAVE LAVAMANOS 1001 AQUAKIT J1001 UNIDAD -@`.
+- Pipe seal/joining consumables: `TEFLON`, PVC adhesive/cement, and rubber
+  seals only when their wording names the pipe system. Evidence: `TEFLON
+  MAESTRO 3/4"`, `ADHESIVO VINILIT 240CC.SECADO LENTO`, and
+  `AQ-GOMA SELLO AQUAPLUV TIGRE -@`.
+- Tank/pipe take-offs and irrigation fittings that themselves name a plumbing
+  material: `COLLAR ARRANQUE`, `COLLARIN POLIPROPILENO`, `SALIDA ESTANQUE`,
+  water `FILTRO`, and explicitly water/irrigation connectors. Evidence:
+  `COLLAR ARRANQUE PVC P/PVC 63 X 1"`, `SALIDA ESTANQUE CEM 63 X 2 -@`, and
+  `FILTRO AGUA PVC NEGRO 2 PULG. PRAKTUS -@`.
+
+## Candidate words that are not automatic membership
+
+- `MANGUERA`, `HELIFLEX`, `CAMLOCK`, `STORZ`, generic `ESPIGA`, and generic
+  `ABRAZADERA` can belong to irrigation, a milking parlour, compressed air,
+  gas, a vehicle, or a machine. They are unresolved unless the same wording
+  names water/plumbing use.
+- `LLAVE` also names hand tools and keys. Examples rejected by the broad token:
+  `JGO 10 LLAVES ALLEN TRUPER -@`, `LLAVE STILLSON 14 TRUPER 15838 -@`, and
+  `CANDADO ODIS 340 2 LLAVES`.
+- `BOLA` also names tow balls. `BOLA ARRASTRE` is not a valve.
+- `AGUA` also appears in paint (`ESMALTE AL AGUA ...`), so it is not a rule.
+- `PRESION` appears in washers and gas regulators; it requires pipe/valve
+  context.
+- `PVC` appears outside plumbing, and a generic `TUBO` may be structural or
+  electrical. The line must name the plumbing system/material.
+- Generic `FILTRO`, `BOMBA`, `SELLO`, `GOMA`, `EMPAQUETADURA`, and `ANILLO`
+  are not plumbing vocabulary without system context.
+- Gas-specific hose, regulators, and valves are excluded from this proposal:
+  the standing client convention places gas hoses in `EXP-16.2`, and the
+  2026-09-02 answer discussed farm water and building water plumbing.
+- A service, repair, installation, project, property, or other job description
+  is not a material even if it mentions a pipe or valve. Those rows remain in
+  review under the open construction/use question.
+
+This vocabulary is a candidate generator, not the classifier. Every resulting
+row must still be read in full before it enters either JSONL file.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the plumbing review artifacts incrementally from the fixed backup."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
REPORT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BACKUP = ROOT / "backups/supabase_20260902T153305Z"
PROPOSAL = REPORT / "plumbing_proposal.jsonl"
UNRESOLVED = REPORT / "plumbing_unresolved.jsonl"

TARGET_ID = "e083d23e-208f-4dd2-9916-70871a21e113"
TARGET_CODE = "EXP-14.3"


def norm(value: str | None) -> str:
    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value or "")
    return " ".join(value.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode().upper().split())


def blocked_supplier(supplier: str) -> bool:
    supplier = norm(supplier)
    return any(name in supplier for name in (
        "BANCO BICE", "BANCO DE CHILE", "SANTANDER", "GEA FARM",
    ))


def job_line(item: str) -> bool:
    return bool(re.search(
        r"\b(SERVICIO|SERVICIOS|INSTALACION|REPARACION|MANTENCION|PROYECTO|"
        r"CONSTRUCCION|CAMBIO|TRASLADO|CONFECCION|MANO DE OBRA|ARREGLO|"
        r"FABRICAR|MANTENCION)\b",
        item,
    )) and "KIT INSTALACION FOSA SEPTICA" not in item


def proposed_group(row: dict, supplier: str) -> str | None:
    item = norm(row.get("item_text"))
    desc = norm(row.get("description"))
    text = f"{item} | {desc}"

    if blocked_supplier(supplier) or job_line(item):
        return None
    if re.search(
        r"\bGAS\b|NEUMATIC|MOTO\b|MOTOR\b|TRACTOR|VEHIC|INFLADO|LECHE|"
        r"SERAP|REFRIGER|COMPRESOR|CONDUIT|INYECCION",
        text,
    ):
        return None
    if "RODILLO TERMOFUSIONADO" in text or "TUBO DE DUCHA ESQUINERO" in text:
        return None

    if re.search(
        r"AQUAPLUV|PVC[ -]?SANIT|SANITARIO GRIS|SANIT\.GRIS|PVC-S\b|"
        r"DESAGUE|SIFON|FOSA SEPTICA|TUBO DRENAJE|Y SANITARIA|CURVA SANITARIA|"
        r"JUEGO DE FITTING PARA SANITARIO|"
        r"(?:CANALETA|TUBO BAJADA|ABRAZADERA TUBO BAJADA|TAPA CANALETA|"
        r"GANCHO FIJAC CANALETA|CODO HEMBRA/HEMBRA).*?(?:P25|VINILIT)",
        text,
    ):
        return "building_drainage"

    if re.search(r"\bPPR\b|TERMOFUS|TUBERIA FUSION", text):
        return "building_ppr"

    if re.search(
        r"FLEXIBLE (?:AGUA|CALEFONT)|KIT LLAVE ANGULAR.*FLEXIBLE|"
        r"LLAVE (?:ANGULAR|LAVAMANOS|DUCHA)|COMBINACION LAVAPLATOS|GRIFERIA|"
        r"MONOMANDO (?:DUCHA|LAVAPLATO)|JUEGO DUCHA|SET DUCHA|MANGO DUCHA|"
        r"RECEPTACULO DUCHA|^LAVAPLATO ",
        text,
    ) and "MUEBLE" not in text:
        return "building_fixture"

    if re.search(
        r"PVC.*PRESION|PRESION.*(?:PVC|VNT)|PVC-H CEM|ADHESIVO PVC|"
        r"ADHESIVO VINILIT|CEMENTO PVC|\bHDPE\b|\bPEAD\b|"
        r"CANERIA POLIETILENO|CANERIA COBRE.*AGUA|TUBERIA CLASE .*PRESION|"
        r"TUBERIA LLDPE|TIRA TUBO COLECTOR|PVC HIDR",
        text,
    ):
        return "farm_pipe"

    if re.search(
        r"COLLAR(?:IN| ARRANQUE).*?(?:PVC|POLIPROP)|SALIDA ESTANQUE|"
        r"FILTRO AGUA|FILTRO MALLA PURIFICACION|MICROTUBO|ASPERSOR|GOTERO|"
        r"AP TAPON BEBEDEROS",
        text,
    ):
        return "farm_water_specific"

    component = (
        r"(?:BUSHING|NIP+LE|NIPPLE|COPLA|CODO|TEE|UNION|TERMINAL|ADAPTADOR|"
        r"REDUCCION|TAPON|CURVA|CRUZ|VEE|BUJE)"
    )
    context = (
        r"(?:\bHI\b|\bHE\b|\bSO\b|GALV|PVC|PPR|PLANSA|COMPRESION|\bCEM\b|"
        r"HILO|PLAST|BRONCE|ALUMINIO|POLIPROP)"
    )
    if re.search(component + r".*" + context, text) or re.search(
        context + r".*" + component, text
    ):
        if not re.search(r"MANGUERA|ESPIGA|MARIPOSA", text):
            return "threaded_fitting"

    if re.search(
        r"^(?:CODO (?:1/2|25MM|90 20MM PRESION|SOLDAR)|"
        r"COPLA(?:$| 20MM| 25MM| SOLDAR| ROSCADA)|NIPLE PP |"
        r"ADAPTADOR LLAVE HEMBRA|ADAPTADOR MACHO 3/4 BRO|TEE ROSCADA PN16)",
        item,
    ):
        return "threaded_fitting"

    if re.search(
        r"VALVULA (?:DE )?BOLA|VALVULA (?:BOLA|COMPACTA|COMPTA|COMPRESION|"
        r"REGULADORA DE PRESION|VENTOSA|RETENCION VERTICAL)|"
        r"LLAVE (?:DE )?BOLA|LLAVE BOLA JARDIN|LLAVE PASO|FLOTADOR [0-9]|"
        r"MINI VALVULA ESPIGA-HE",
        text,
    ):
        return "valve_tap"

    if re.search(r"\bTEFLON\b", text):
        return "sealant"

    if re.search(
        r"MANGUERA.*JARDIN|JARDIN.*MANGUERA|MANGUERA.*AGUA|"
        r"CONECTOR RAPIDO.*REHAU|CONECTOR.*GARDTECH",
        text,
    ):
        return "explicit_water_hose"

    return None


def unresolved_reason(row: dict, supplier: str) -> str | None:
    item = norm(row.get("item_text"))
    desc = norm(row.get("description"))
    text = f"{item} | {desc}"

    if blocked_supplier(supplier):
        return None
    if re.search(r"\bGAS\b|NEUMATIC|MOTO\b|MOTOR\b|TRACTOR|VEHIC|INFLADO|LECHE|SERAP|REFRIGER|CONDUIT|INYECCION|PQS", text):
        return None
    if proposed_group(row, supplier):
        return None

    if re.search(r"MANGUERA|HELIFLEX|CAMLOCK|STORZ|ESPIGA", text):
        return "Generic hose or hose coupling; the wording does not identify water/plumbing rather than irrigation, machinery, or another system."
    if re.search(r"\bABRAZ(?:ADERA|\.)", text):
        return "Generic clamp; the wording does not identify the pipe, hose, machine, or job it was bought for."
    if re.search(r"(?:CANERIA|TUBERIA) (?:COBRE|L )|^PVC$|TUBO A\.R\.B/P", item):
        return "A pipe-like material is named, but the wording does not settle water plumbing versus refrigeration, machinery, or construction use."
    if re.search(r"ACOPLE(?:S| RAPIDO)|CONECTOR RAP |BUSHING NYLON|SELLO ANTIFUGA|TAPON (?:REUSABLE|UNIVERSAL)", text):
        return "Generic fitting; the wording lacks a named pipe/fluid system, so plumbing use cannot be established from the line alone."
    if re.search(r"MATERIAL(?:ES)? (?:RED AGUA|DE RIEGO)|REPUESTOS MANTENCION ESTANQUE", text):
        return "The line says materials/parts for a water-related system but does not name the actual material; proposing it would classify a job bundle, not an evidenced item."
    if re.search(r"CARTUCHO REPUESTO FILTRO 80 MICRAS|CONTENEDOR DE FILTRO MEDIANO", text):
        return "A fluid-filter component is named, but the wording does not identify the water, irrigation, milking, or machine system."
    return None


def output_row(row: dict, supplier: str, *, group: str | None = None, reason: str | None = None) -> dict:
    result = {
        "item_id": row["item_id"],
        "item_text": row.get("item_text"),
        "description": row.get("description"),
        "supplier": supplier,
        "amount": row.get("amount"),
        "current_predicted_code": row.get("predicted_code"),
    }
    if group:
        evidence = row.get("item_text") or row.get("description")
        result.update({
            "proposed_code": TARGET_CODE,
            "proposed_categories_id": TARGET_ID,
            "evidence": evidence,
        })
    else:
        result["reason"] = reason
    return result


def read_existing(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]


def append_rows(path: Path, rows: list[dict]) -> None:
    existing = read_existing(path)
    seen = {row["item_id"] for row in existing}
    overlap = seen & {row["item_id"] for row in rows}
    if overlap:
        raise SystemExit(f"refusing duplicate append to {path.name}: {len(overlap)} item_ids")
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        for row in rows:
            handle.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--proposal-group")
    parser.add_argument("--list-group")
    parser.add_argument("--unresolved", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--list-unresolved", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--summary", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    items = [json.loads(line) for line in (BACKUP / "invoice_items.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    invoices = {row["invoice_id"]: row for row in map(json.loads, (BACKUP / "invoices.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())}
    review = [row for row in items if row.get("decision") != "auto_accept" and row.get("final_categories_id") is None]
    assert len(review) == 4411

    proposed: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    unresolved: list[dict] = []
    for row in review:
        supplier = invoices[row["invoice_id"]]["seller_name"]
        group = proposed_group(row, supplier)
        if group:
            proposed.setdefault(group, []).append(output_row(row, supplier, group=group))
            continue
        reason = unresolved_reason(row, supplier)
        if reason:
            unresolved.append(output_row(row, supplier, reason=reason))

    proposed_ids = {row["item_id"] for rows in proposed.values() for row in rows}
    unresolved_ids = {row["item_id"] for row in unresolved}
    assert not proposed_ids & unresolved_ids

    if args.summary:
        for group, rows in sorted(proposed.items()):
            print(f"proposal {group:24} {len(rows):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in rows):,}")
        print(f"proposal TOTAL{'':18} {len(proposed_ids):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for rows in proposed.values() for row in rows):,}")
        by_reason: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
        for row in unresolved:
            by_reason.setdefault(row["reason"], []).append(row)
        for reason, rows in by_reason.items():
            print(f"unresolved {len(rows):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in rows):,}  {reason}")
        print(f"unresolved TOTAL {len(unresolved):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in unresolved):,}")

    if args.list_group:
        rows = proposed.get(args.list_group)
        if rows is None:
            raise SystemExit(f"unknown proposal group {args.list_group!r}; choices: {sorted(proposed)}")
        for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda row: (norm(row["item_text"]), row["item_id"])):
            print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
    if args.list_unresolved:
        for row in sorted(unresolved, key=lambda row: (row["reason"], norm(row["item_text"]), row["item_id"])):
            print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))

    if args.proposal_group:
        rows = proposed.get(args.proposal_group)
        if rows is None:
            raise SystemExit(f"unknown proposal group {args.proposal_group!r}; choices: {sorted(proposed)}")
        append_rows(PROPOSAL, sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row["item_id"]))
        print(f"appended {len(rows)} {args.proposal_group} rows to {PROPOSAL.name}")

## Decisions relied on

- **D-030 — client authority outranks row volume.** Cristian's written answer
  that building and farm plumbing all go to `EXP-14.3` is the governing label,
  even where the current model predicts another code.
- **D-041 — do not resolve an open client question in the payload.** A service,
  project, place, generic hardware item, or use-ambiguous material stays in
  review. Construction, bale-making, and the hardware-store default are not
  inferred here.
- **D-042 — backing gold `source`, not `prediction_source`, carries authority.**
  This pass does not use `prediction_source` as evidence. The authority is the
  client's 2026-09-02 answer recorded above.
- **D-043 — surface decisions before acting.** This batch report records the
  load-bearing decisions before the proposal; the non-interactive run does not
  pause for confirmation.
- The hard limits remain intact: no row is added to gold, no unaudited row is
  promoted to gold, and no category is created. `EXP-14.3` already exists as
  categories_id `e083d23e-208f-4dd2-9916-70871a21e113`.

## Source and population

All measurements use only
`backups/supabase_20260902T153305Z/`, taken
2026-09-02T15:33:05Z. Its manifest reports 11,746 `invoice_items` rows and
SHA-256 `4c43c93076f3116d81e6c2f707291c2af98ea67ba1d5e761e96a2ef2af276206`.
The review population is re-derived as:

```text
decision != 'auto_accept' AND final_categories_id IS NULL
= 4,411 lines, CLP 949,052,038
```

Only those 4,411 lines are eligible. Supplier comes from the matching local
`invoices.jsonl` row. No Supabase connection or other external source is used.
Bank suppliers (BICE, Banco de Chile, Santander) and GEA are explicitly outside
this lane and cannot enter the proposal.

## Vocabulary method

The data-first working is preserved in `VOCABULARY.md`. The five highest-volume
hardware/building-material suppliers contribute 1,463 review lines worth
CLP 27,400,346. Their most frequent material signals generated candidates; the
full `item_text` and every populated `description` were then read before a row
could be proposed.

Hardware-store membership is never an inclusion rule. It is only where the
vocabulary search began. A hardware row enters this proposal only when its own
wording names a plumbing material. Conversely, a plumbing material from a
different supplier remains eligible. This keeps Cristian's two answers apart:
there is no default for hardware purchases, but a specifically named plumbing
material has the settled `EXP-14.3` destination.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build the plumbing review artifacts incrementally from the fixed backup."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import re
+import unicodedata
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+REPORT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = ROOT / "backups/supabase_20260902T153305Z"
+PROPOSAL = REPORT / "plumbing_proposal.jsonl"
+UNRESOLVED = REPORT / "plumbing_unresolved.jsonl"
+
+TARGET_ID = "e083d23e-208f-4dd2-9916-70871a21e113"
+TARGET_CODE = "EXP-14.3"
+
+
+def norm(value: str | None) -> str:
+    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value or "")
+    return " ".join(value.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode().upper().split())
+
+
+def blocked_supplier(supplier: str) -> bool:
+    supplier = norm(supplier)
+    return any(name in supplier for name in (
+        "BANCO BICE", "BANCO DE CHILE", "SANTANDER", "GEA FARM",
+    ))
+
+
+def job_line(item: str) -> bool:
+    return bool(re.search(
+        r"\b(SERVICIO|SERVICIOS|INSTALACION|REPARACION|MANTENCION|PROYECTO|"
+        r"CONSTRUCCION|CAMBIO|TRASLADO|CONFECCION|MANO DE OBRA|ARREGLO|"
+        r"FABRICAR|MANTENCION)\b",
+        item,
+    )) and "KIT INSTALACION FOSA SEPTICA" not in item
+
+
+def proposed_group(row: dict, supplier: str) -> str | None:
+    item = norm(row.get("item_text"))
+    desc = norm(row.get("description"))
+    text = f"{item} | {desc}"
+
+    if blocked_supplier(supplier) or job_line(item):
+        return None
+    if re.search(
+        r"\bGAS\b|NEUMATIC|MOTO\b|MOTOR\b|TRACTOR|VEHIC|INFLADO|LECHE|"
+        r"SERAP|REFRIGER|COMPRESOR|CONDUIT|INYECCION",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return None
+    if "RODILLO TERMOFUSIONADO" in text or "TUBO DE DUCHA ESQUINERO" in text:
+        return None
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"AQUAPLUV|PVC[ -]?SANIT|SANITARIO GRIS|SANIT\.GRIS|PVC-S\b|"
+        r"DESAGUE|SIFON|FOSA SEPTICA|TUBO DRENAJE|Y SANITARIA|CURVA SANITARIA|"
+        r"JUEGO DE FITTING PARA SANITARIO|"
+        r"(?:CANALETA|TUBO BAJADA|ABRAZADERA TUBO BAJADA|TAPA CANALETA|"
+        r"GANCHO FIJAC CANALETA|CODO HEMBRA/HEMBRA).*?(?:P25|VINILIT)",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "building_drainage"
+
+    if re.search(r"\bPPR\b|TERMOFUS|TUBERIA FUSION", text):
+        return "building_ppr"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"FLEXIBLE (?:AGUA|CALEFONT)|KIT LLAVE ANGULAR.*FLEXIBLE|"
+        r"LLAVE (?:ANGULAR|LAVAMANOS|DUCHA)|COMBINACION LAVAPLATOS|GRIFERIA|"
+        r"MONOMANDO (?:DUCHA|LAVAPLATO)|JUEGO DUCHA|SET DUCHA|MANGO DUCHA|"
+        r"RECEPTACULO DUCHA|^LAVAPLATO ",
+        text,
+    ) and "MUEBLE" not in text:
+        return "building_fixture"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"PVC.*PRESION|PRESION.*(?:PVC|VNT)|PVC-H CEM|ADHESIVO PVC|"
+        r"ADHESIVO VINILIT|CEMENTO PVC|\bHDPE\b|\bPEAD\b|"
+        r"CANERIA POLIETILENO|CANERIA COBRE.*AGUA|TUBERIA CLASE .*PRESION|"
+        r"TUBERIA LLDPE|TIRA TUBO COLECTOR|PVC HIDR",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "farm_pipe"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"COLLAR(?:IN| ARRANQUE).*?(?:PVC|POLIPROP)|SALIDA ESTANQUE|"
+        r"FILTRO AGUA|FILTRO MALLA PURIFICACION|MICROTUBO|ASPERSOR|GOTERO|"
+        r"AP TAPON BEBEDEROS",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "farm_water_specific"
+
+    component = (
+        r"(?:BUSHING|NIP+LE|NIPPLE|COPLA|CODO|TEE|UNION|TERMINAL|ADAPTADOR|"
+        r"REDUCCION|TAPON|CURVA|CRUZ|VEE|BUJE)"
+    )
+    context = (
+        r"(?:\bHI\b|\bHE\b|\bSO\b|GALV|PVC|PPR|PLANSA|COMPRESION|\bCEM\b|"
+        r"HILO|PLAST|BRONCE|ALUMINIO|POLIPROP)"
+    )
+    if re.search(component + r".*" + context, text) or re.search(
+        context + r".*" + component, text
+    ):
+        if not re.search(r"MANGUERA|ESPIGA|MARIPOSA", text):
+            return "threaded_fitting"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"^(?:CODO (?:1/2|25MM|90 20MM PRESION|SOLDAR)|"
+        r"COPLA(?:$| 20MM| 25MM| SOLDAR| ROSCADA)|NIPLE PP |"
+        r"ADAPTADOR LLAVE HEMBRA|ADAPTADOR MACHO 3/4 BRO|TEE ROSCADA PN16)",
+        item,
+    ):
+        return "threaded_fitting"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"VALVULA (?:DE )?BOLA|VALVULA (?:BOLA|COMPACTA|COMPTA|COMPRESION|"
+        r"REGULADORA DE PRESION|VENTOSA|RETENCION VERTICAL)|"
+        r"LLAVE (?:DE )?BOLA|LLAVE BOLA JARDIN|LLAVE PASO|FLOTADOR [0-9]|"
+        r"MINI VALVULA ESPIGA-HE",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "valve_tap"
+
+    if re.search(r"\bTEFLON\b", text):
+        return "sealant"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"MANGUERA.*JARDIN|JARDIN.*MANGUERA|MANGUERA.*AGUA|"
+        r"CONECTOR RAPIDO.*REHAU|CONECTOR.*GARDTECH",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "explicit_water_hose"
+
+    return None
+
+
+def unresolved_reason(row: dict, supplier: str) -> str | None:
+    item = norm(row.get("item_text"))
+    desc = norm(row.get("description"))
+    text = f"{item} | {desc}"
+
+    if blocked_supplier(supplier):
+        return None
+    if re.search(r"\bGAS\b|NEUMATIC|MOTO\b|MOTOR\b|TRACTOR|VEHIC|INFLADO|LECHE|SERAP|REFRIGER|CONDUIT|INYECCION|PQS", text):
+        return None
+    if proposed_group(row, supplier):
+        return None
+
+    if re.search(r"MANGUERA|HELIFLEX|CAMLOCK|STORZ|ESPIGA", text):
+        return "Generic hose or hose coupling; the wording does not identify water/plumbing rather than irrigation, machinery, or another system."
+    if re.search(r"\bABRAZ(?:ADERA|\.)", text):
+        return "Generic clamp; the wording does not identify the pipe, hose, machine, or job it was bought for."
+    if re.search(r"(?:CANERIA|TUBERIA) (?:COBRE|L )|^PVC$|TUBO A\.R\.B/P", item):
+        return "A pipe-like material is named, but the wording does not settle water plumbing versus refrigeration, machinery, or construction use."
+    if re.search(r"ACOPLE(?:S| RAPIDO)|CONECTOR RAP |BUSHING NYLON|SELLO ANTIFUGA|TAPON (?:REUSABLE|UNIVERSAL)", text):
+        return "Generic fitting; the wording lacks a named pipe/fluid system, so plumbing use cannot be established from the line alone."
+    if re.search(r"MATERIAL(?:ES)? (?:RED AGUA|DE RIEGO)|REPUESTOS MANTENCION ESTANQUE", text):
+        return "The line says materials/parts for a water-related system but does not name the actual material; proposing it would classify a job bundle, not an evidenced item."
+    if re.search(r"CARTUCHO REPUESTO FILTRO 80 MICRAS|CONTENEDOR DE FILTRO MEDIANO", text):
+        return "A fluid-filter component is named, but the wording does not identify the water, irrigation, milking, or machine system."
+    return None
+
+
+def output_row(row: dict, supplier: str, *, group: str | None = None, reason: str | None = None) -> dict:
+    result = {
+        "item_id": row["item_id"],
+        "item_text": row.get("item_text"),
+        "description": row.get("description"),
+        "supplier": supplier,
+        "amount": row.get("amount"),
+        "current_predicted_code": row.get("predicted_code"),
+    }
+    if group:
+        evidence = row.get("item_text") or row.get("description")
+        result.update({
+            "proposed_code": TARGET_CODE,
+            "proposed_categories_id": TARGET_ID,
+            "evidence": evidence,
+        })
+    else:
+        result["reason"] = reason
+    return result
+
+
+def read_existing(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
+
+
+def append_rows(path: Path, rows: list[dict]) -> None:
+    existing = read_existing(path)
+    seen = {row["item_id"] for row in existing}
+    overlap = seen & {row["item_id"] for row in rows}
+    if overlap:
+        raise SystemExit(f"refusing duplicate append to {path.name}: {len(overlap)} item_ids")
+    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        for row in rows:
+            handle.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--proposal-group")
+    parser.add_argument("--list-group")
+    parser.add_argument("--unresolved", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--list-unresolved", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--summary", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    items = [json.loads(line) for line in (BACKUP / "invoice_items.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
+    invoices = {row["invoice_id"]: row for row in map(json.loads, (BACKUP / "invoices.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())}
+    review = [row for row in items if row.get("decision") != "auto_accept" and row.get("final_categories_id") is None]
+    assert len(review) == 4411
+
+    proposed: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
+    unresolved: list[dict] = []
+    for row in review:
+        supplier = invoices[row["invoice_id"]]["seller_name"]
+        group = proposed_group(row, supplier)
+        if group:
+            proposed.setdefault(group, []).append(output_row(row, supplier, group=group))
+            continue
+        reason = unresolved_reason(row, supplier)
+        if reason:
+            unresolved.append(output_row(row, supplier, reason=reason))
+
+    proposed_ids = {row["item_id"] for rows in proposed.values() for row in rows}
+    unresolved_ids = {row["item_id"] for row in unresolved}
+    assert not proposed_ids & unresolved_ids
+
+    if args.summary:
+        for group, rows in sorted(proposed.items()):
+            print(f"proposal {group:24} {len(rows):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in rows):,}")
+        print(f"proposal TOTAL{'':18} {len(proposed_ids):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for rows in proposed.values() for row in rows):,}")
+        by_reason: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
+        for row in unresolved:
+            by_reason.setdefault(row["reason"], []).append(row)
+        for reason, rows in by_reason.items():
+            print(f"unresolved {len(rows):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in rows):,}  {reason}")
+        print(f"unresolved TOTAL {len(unresolved):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in unresolved):,}")
+
+    if args.list_group:
+        rows = proposed.get(args.list_group)
+        if rows is None:
+            raise SystemExit(f"unknown proposal group {args.list_group!r}; choices: {sorted(proposed)}")
+        for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda row: (norm(row["item_text"]), row["item_id"])):
+            print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
+    if args.list_unresolved:
+        for row in sorted(unresolved, key=lambda row: (row["reason"], norm(row["item_text"]), row["item_id"])):
+            print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+    if args.proposal_group:
+        rows = proposed.get(args.proposal_group)
+        if rows is None:
+            raise SystemExit(f"unknown proposal group {args.proposal_group!r}; choices: {sorted(proposed)}")
+        append_rows(PROPOSAL, sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row["item_id"]))
+        print(f"appended {len(rows)} {args.proposal_group} rows to {PROPOSAL.name}")
+    if args.unresolved:
+        append_rows(UNRESOLVED, sorted(unresolved, key=lambda row: row["item_id"]))
+        print(f"appended {len(unresolved)} rows to {UNRESOLVED.name}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Plumbing material vocabulary
+
+Measured only from `backups/supabase_20260902T153305Z/`, taken
+2026-09-02T15:33:05Z. The exported `invoice_items.jsonl` has 11,746 rows and
+SHA-256 `4c43c93076f3116d81e6c2f707291c2af98ea67ba1d5e761e96a2ef2af276206`.
+The working population is the 4,411 rows where `decision != 'auto_accept'` and
+`final_categories_id IS NULL`.
+
+This is the vocabulary checkpoint required before classification. It records
+how candidate words were found and which actual invoice lines make each word
+usable. A word is not sufficient by itself: the final proposal reads every
+matched `item_text` and `description` row by row.
+
+## Starting population: five hardware suppliers
+
+The five suppliers were selected mechanically: the five highest review-row
+counts whose invoice `seller_giro` or name says ferreteria/hardware or building
+materials. Together they contribute 1,463 review lines worth CLP 27,400,346.
+
+| supplier | review lines |
+|---|---:|
+| DORIS IVONNE CASTILLO KANTER | 800 |
+| COMERCIAL CLIMENT SPA | 269 |
+| SODIMAC S.A. | 232 |
+| COMERCIAL HARCHA SPA | 127 |
+| PUELCHE LOS RIOS SOCIEDAD POR ACCIONES | 35 |
+
+The next supplier in that measured ranking is FERRETERIAS WEITZLER SOCIEDAD
+ANONIMA with 18 review lines; it was not silently substituted into the stated
+five-supplier starting set.
+
+## Frequent-token working
+
+Token counts below mean distinct review lines from the five suppliers whose
+`item_text` contains that accent-folded token. CLP sums the full line amounts;
+it is a discovery measure, not a plumbing total, because ambiguous tokens such
+as `ABRAZADERA`, `MANGUERA`, `LLAVE`, and `AGUA` also occur in non-plumbing
+products.
+
+| token | lines | CLP | example that caused inspection |
+|---|---:|---:|---|
+| PVC | 67 | 499,838 | `TUBO PVC PRESION C/16 20 MM` |
+| VALVULA | 67 | 2,176,713 | `Válvula de Bola PP 32mm HI Arangül` |
+| CODO | 54 | 177,597 | `Codo Compresión 32mm Arangül` |
+| ABRAZADERA | 49 | 253,507 | `ABRAZADERA MANGUERA 1 PULG 19MM A 38MM AB-12 -@` |
+| TERMINAL | 43 | 127,743 | `PL-TERMINAL HE 1 2 PLANSA -@` |
+| TEE | 42 | 391,801 | `Tee Compresión HI 63mm GS Pimtas` |
+| MANGUERA | 38 | 651,047 | `MANGUERA JARDIN RAYADA ECONOMICA 1 2 -@` |
+| BUSHING | 36 | 60,601 | `BUSHING PLAST.BCO.HI HE 1 X 3/4"` |
+| LLAVE | 35 | 311,009 | `LLAVE ANGULAR C/FLEX. 1/2HI X 15/16HI 30CM HOFFENS` |
+| UNION | 30 | 237,286 | `UNION STORZ SIMPLE COLA LARGA 2"` |
+| PPR | 24 | 49,630 | `FU-TUBERIA FUSION 20MM O PPR -@` |
+| COPLA | 24 | 81,711 | `COPLA GALVANIZADA 1,1/2"` |
+| NIPLE | 22 | 41,108 | `NIPLE HEXAGONO GALVANIZADO 1"` |
+| TEFLON | 22 | 67,079 | `CINTA TEFLON GENEBRE 50 MTS X 19 MM -@` |
+| PLANSA | 21 | 68,070 | `PL-UNION DOBLE 1 PLANSA -@` |
+| COMPRESION | 21 | 446,254 | `Tee Compresión HI 32mm Arangül` |
+| SANITARIO | 21 | 143,414 | `Ñ-CODO SANITARIO GRIS 40MM -@` |
+| TERMOFUSION | 21 | 70,603 | `ADAPTADOR SO HI P/TERMOFUSION 20 X 1/2` |
+| AQUAPLUV | 18 | 171,796 | `AQ-TEE BAJADA AQUAPLUV TIGRE -@` |
+| FLEXIBLE | 19 | 207,387 | `FLEXIBLE AGUA 1 2 X 1 2 HI-HI 40CM YTS F40HI-@` |
+| HDPE | 15 | 266,268 | `HDPE-TEE COMPRESION 63MM -@` |
+| TAPON | 14 | 100,585 | `TAPON GORRO PVC-H CEM. 110MM.` |
+| ADAPTADOR | 14 | 115,279 | `ADAPTADOR SO HI P/TERMOFUSION 20 X 1/2` |
+| ARRANQUE | 11 | 164,589 | `COLLAR ARRANQUE PVC P/PVC 40 X 3/4"` |
+| ACOPLE | 11 | 219,205 | `CAMLOCK ACOPLE HEMBRA TIPO-B HE 2"` |
+| CONECTOR | 11 | 35,130 | `CONECTOR RAPIDO 1/2 C/STOP REHAU (268133300)` |
+| HELIFLEX | 11 | 543,933 | `HELIFLEX LIVIANA C/ANILLO 3" (75MM)` |
+
+## Accepted vocabulary, with the lines that justify it
+
+The accepted vocabulary is deliberately made of material families plus
+context. The example after each entry is an exact line from the review queue.
+
+- Sanitary/drainage PVC: `PVC-SANIT`, `PVC SANITARIO`, `SANITARIO GRIS`,
+  `DESAGUE`, `SIFON`, and `VEE` when paired with sanitary PVC. Evidence:
+  `* MT.X TIRA PVC-SANITARIO GRIS 110MM CERTIFICADA CESM`,
+  `Ñ-TEE REGISTRO 110 PVC-SANITARIO HOFFENS -@`, and
+  `DESAGUE TINA/RECEPTACULO E70 X S1,1/4" 9052642 VINIL`.
+- PPR/thermofusion water pipe and fittings: `PPR`, `TERMOFUSION`, and the
+  `FU-` product family. Evidence: `FU-TUBERIA FUSION 20MM O PPR -@`,
+  `FU-CODO 20MM PPR -@`, and `TUBO TERMOFUSION PN 20 20MM X 6 MT`.
+- Rainwater drainage: `AQUAPLUV`, and `TUBO BAJADA`/`CANALETA` only when the
+  wording identifies the gutter system. Evidence: `AQ-GOMA SELLO AQUAPLUV
+  TIGRE -@`, `AQ-TUBO BAJADA X 3 METROS -ACQ-TIGRE -@`, and
+  `UNION CANALETA ARENA P25- VINILIT`.
+- Pressure-water PVC: `PVC PRESION`, `PVC-H CEM`, and PVC cement/adhesive.
+  Evidence: `TUBO PVC PRESION C/16 20 MM`, `TAPON GORRO PVC-H CEM. 110MM.`,
+  and `ADHESIVO PVC VINILIT C/BROCHA TRADICIONAL 240 CC`.
+- HDPE/polyethylene compression water fittings: `HDPE`, and `COMPRESION` when
+  attached to a named pipe fitting. Evidence: `HDPE-TEE COMPRESION 63MM -@`,
+  `Codo Compresión 32mm Arangül`, and `Válvula Compresión HE 32mm Arangül`.
+- Threaded pipe fittings: `BUSHING`, `NIPLE`/`NIPPLE`, `COPLA`, `CODO`, `TEE`,
+  `UNION`, `TERMINAL`, `ADAPTADOR`, `REDUCCION`, `TAPON`, `CURVA`, and `CRUZ`
+  when the wording includes pipe-thread markers/material (`HI`, `HE`, `SO`,
+  galvanised, plastic, PVC, PPR, PLANSA, compression). Evidence:
+  `-BUSHING REDUCCION HE-HI 1 X 3 4 -@`, `GG-NIPPLE HE-HE GALV 2 1 2 -@`,
+  `TEE GALVANIZADA 3/4"`, and `PL-TERMINAL HE 1 2 PLANSA -@`.
+- Water valves and taps: `VALVULA DE BOLA`, `VALVULA COMPACTA`,
+  `LLAVE BOLA JARDIN`, `LLAVE ANGULAR`, water `LLAVE PASO`, `FLOTADOR`, and
+  `VENTOSA`, except when the line explicitly names gas, a vehicle, a machine,
+  or a milking-system component. Evidence: `VALVULA DE BOLA HI ITALI 1"`,
+  `LLAVE BOLA JARDIN PN16 DE 3 4 X 1 GENEBRE -@`, and
+  `Válvula Ventosa Triple 2" GTR`.
+- Plumbing fixture connections: water/calefont `FLEXIBLE`, `SIFON`, `DESAGUE`,
+  and named taps or sanitary fixtures. Evidence: `FLEXIBLE CALEFONT 1/2HI X
+  1/2HI X 25CM 051033211 TAUM`, `SIFON LAVAPLATOS LOA HOFFENS S/CURVA -@`,
+  and `LLAVE LAVAMANOS 1001 AQUAKIT J1001 UNIDAD -@`.
+- Pipe seal/joining consumables: `TEFLON`, PVC adhesive/cement, and rubber
+  seals only when their wording names the pipe system. Evidence: `TEFLON
+  MAESTRO 3/4"`, `ADHESIVO VINILIT 240CC.SECADO LENTO`, and
+  `AQ-GOMA SELLO AQUAPLUV TIGRE -@`.
+- Tank/pipe take-offs and irrigation fittings that themselves name a plumbing
+  material: `COLLAR ARRANQUE`, `COLLARIN POLIPROPILENO`, `SALIDA ESTANQUE`,
+  water `FILTRO`, and explicitly water/irrigation connectors. Evidence:
+  `COLLAR ARRANQUE PVC P/PVC 63 X 1"`, `SALIDA ESTANQUE CEM 63 X 2 -@`, and
+  `FILTRO AGUA PVC NEGRO 2 PULG. PRAKTUS -@`.
+
+## Candidate words that are not automatic membership
+
+- `MANGUERA`, `HELIFLEX`, `CAMLOCK`, `STORZ`, generic `ESPIGA`, and generic
+  `ABRAZADERA` can belong to irrigation, a milking parlour, compressed air,
+  gas, a vehicle, or a machine. They are unresolved unless the same wording
+  names water/plumbing use.
+- `LLAVE` also names hand tools and keys. Examples rejected by the broad token:
+  `JGO 10 LLAVES ALLEN TRUPER -@`, `LLAVE STILLSON 14 TRUPER 15838 -@`, and
+  `CANDADO ODIS 340 2 LLAVES`.
+- `BOLA` also names tow balls. `BOLA ARRASTRE` is not a valve.
+- `AGUA` also appears in paint (`ESMALTE AL AGUA ...`), so it is not a rule.
+- `PRESION` appears in washers and gas regulators; it requires pipe/valve
+  context.
+- `PVC` appears outside plumbing, and a generic `TUBO` may be structural or
+  electrical. The line must name the plumbing system/material.
+- Generic `FILTRO`, `BOMBA`, `SELLO`, `GOMA`, `EMPAQUETADURA`, and `ANILLO`
+  are not plumbing vocabulary without system context.
+- Gas-specific hose, regulators, and valves are excluded from this proposal:
+  the standing client convention places gas hoses in `EXP-16.2`, and the
+  2026-09-02 answer discussed farm water and building water plumbing.
+- A service, repair, installation, project, property, or other job description
+  is not a material even if it mentions a pipe or valve. Those rows remain in
+  review under the open construction/use question.
+
+This vocabulary is a candidate generator, not the classifier. Every resulting
+row must still be read in full before it enters either JSONL file.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build the plumbing review artifacts incrementally from the fixed backup."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import re
+import unicodedata
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+REPORT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BACKUP = ROOT / "backups/supabase_20260902T153305Z"
+PROPOSAL = REPORT / "plumbing_proposal.jsonl"
+UNRESOLVED = REPORT / "plumbing_unresolved.jsonl"
+
+TARGET_ID = "e083d23e-208f-4dd2-9916-70871a21e113"
+TARGET_CODE = "EXP-14.3"
+
+
+def norm(value: str | None) -> str:
+    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value or "")
+    return " ".join(value.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode().upper().split())
+
+
+def blocked_supplier(supplier: str) -> bool:
+    supplier = norm(supplier)
+    return any(name in supplier for name in (
+        "BANCO BICE", "BANCO DE CHILE", "SANTANDER", "GEA FARM",
+    ))
+
+
+def job_line(item: str) -> bool:
+    return bool(re.search(
+        r"\b(SERVICIO|SERVICIOS|INSTALACION|REPARACION|MANTENCION|PROYECTO|"
+        r"CONSTRUCCION|CAMBIO|TRASLADO|CONFECCION|MANO DE OBRA|ARREGLO|"
+        r"FABRICAR|MANTENCION)\b",
+        item,
+    )) and "KIT INSTALACION FOSA SEPTICA" not in item
+
+
+def proposed_group(row: dict, supplier: str) -> str | None:
+    item = norm(row.get("item_text"))
+    desc = norm(row.get("description"))
+    text = f"{item} | {desc}"
+
+    if blocked_supplier(supplier) or job_line(item):
+        return None
+    if re.search(
+        r"\bGAS\b|NEUMATIC|MOTO\b|MOTOR\b|TRACTOR|VEHIC|INFLADO|LECHE|"
+        r"SERAP|REFRIGER|COMPRESOR|CONDUIT|INYECCION",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return None
+    if "RODILLO TERMOFUSIONADO" in text or "TUBO DE DUCHA ESQUINERO" in text:
+        return None
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"AQUAPLUV|PVC[ -]?SANIT|SANITARIO GRIS|SANIT\.GRIS|PVC-S\b|"
+        r"DESAGUE|SIFON|FOSA SEPTICA|TUBO DRENAJE|Y SANITARIA|CURVA SANITARIA|"
+        r"JUEGO DE FITTING PARA SANITARIO|"
+        r"(?:CANALETA|TUBO BAJADA|ABRAZADERA TUBO BAJADA|TAPA CANALETA|"
+        r"GANCHO FIJAC CANALETA|CODO HEMBRA/HEMBRA).*?(?:P25|VINILIT)",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "building_drainage"
+
+    if re.search(r"\bPPR\b|TERMOFUS|TUBERIA FUSION", text):
+        return "building_ppr"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"FLEXIBLE (?:AGUA|CALEFONT)|KIT LLAVE ANGULAR.*FLEXIBLE|"
+        r"LLAVE (?:ANGULAR|LAVAMANOS|DUCHA)|COMBINACION LAVAPLATOS|GRIFERIA|"
+        r"MONOMANDO (?:DUCHA|LAVAPLATO)|JUEGO DUCHA|SET DUCHA|MANGO DUCHA|"
+        r"RECEPTACULO DUCHA|^LAVAPLATO ",
+        text,
+    ) and "MUEBLE" not in text:
+        return "building_fixture"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"PVC.*PRESION|PRESION.*(?:PVC|VNT)|PVC-H CEM|ADHESIVO PVC|"
+        r"ADHESIVO VINILIT|CEMENTO PVC|\bHDPE\b|\bPEAD\b|"
+        r"CANERIA POLIETILENO|CANERIA COBRE.*AGUA|TUBERIA CLASE .*PRESION|"
+        r"TUBERIA LLDPE|TIRA TUBO COLECTOR|PVC HIDR",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "farm_pipe"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"COLLAR(?:IN| ARRANQUE).*?(?:PVC|POLIPROP)|SALIDA ESTANQUE|"
+        r"FILTRO AGUA|FILTRO MALLA PURIFICACION|MICROTUBO|ASPERSOR|GOTERO|"
+        r"AP TAPON BEBEDEROS",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "farm_water_specific"
+
+    component = (
+        r"(?:BUSHING|NIP+LE|NIPPLE|COPLA|CODO|TEE|UNION|TERMINAL|ADAPTADOR|"
+        r"REDUCCION|TAPON|CURVA|CRUZ|VEE|BUJE)"
+    )
+    context = (
+        r"(?:\bHI\b|\bHE\b|\bSO\b|GALV|PVC|PPR|PLANSA|COMPRESION|\bCEM\b|"
+        r"HILO|PLAST|BRONCE|ALUMINIO|POLIPROP)"
+    )
+    if re.search(component + r".*" + context, text) or re.search(
+        context + r".*" + component, text
+    ):
+        if not re.search(r"MANGUERA|ESPIGA|MARIPOSA", text):
+            return "threaded_fitting"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"^(?:CODO (?:1/2|25MM|90 20MM PRESION|SOLDAR)|"
+        r"COPLA(?:$| 20MM| 25MM| SOLDAR| ROSCADA)|NIPLE PP |"
+        r"ADAPTADOR LLAVE HEMBRA|ADAPTADOR MACHO 3/4 BRO|TEE ROSCADA PN16)",
+        item,
+    ):
+        return "threaded_fitting"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"VALVULA (?:DE )?BOLA|VALVULA (?:BOLA|COMPACTA|COMPTA|COMPRESION|"
+        r"REGULADORA DE PRESION|VENTOSA|RETENCION VERTICAL)|"
+        r"LLAVE (?:DE )?BOLA|LLAVE BOLA JARDIN|LLAVE PASO|FLOTADOR [0-9]|"
+        r"MINI VALVULA ESPIGA-HE",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "valve_tap"
+
+    if re.search(r"\bTEFLON\b", text):
+        return "sealant"
+
+    if re.search(
+        r"MANGUERA.*JARDIN|JARDIN.*MANGUERA|MANGUERA.*AGUA|"
+        r"CONECTOR RAPIDO.*REHAU|CONECTOR.*GARDTECH",
+        text,
+    ):
+        return "explicit_water_hose"
+
+    return None
+
+
+def unresolved_reason(row: dict, supplier: str) -> str | None:
+    item = norm(row.get("item_text"))
+    desc = norm(row.get("description"))
+    text = f"{item} | {desc}"
+
+    if blocked_supplier(supplier):
+        return None
+    if re.search(r"\bGAS\b|NEUMATIC|MOTO\b|MOTOR\b|TRACTOR|VEHIC|INFLADO|LECHE|SERAP|REFRIGER|CONDUIT|INYECCION|PQS", text):
+        return None
+    if proposed_group(row, supplier):
+        return None
+
+    if re.search(r"MANGUERA|HELIFLEX|CAMLOCK|STORZ|ESPIGA", text):
+        return "Generic hose or hose coupling; the wording does not identify water/plumbing rather than irrigation, machinery, or another system."
+    if re.search(r"\bABRAZ(?:ADERA|\.)", text):
+        return "Generic clamp; the wording does not identify the pipe, hose, machine, or job it was bought for."
+    if re.search(r"(?:CANERIA|TUBERIA) (?:COBRE|L )|^PVC$|TUBO A\.R\.B/P", item):
+        return "A pipe-like material is named, but the wording does not settle water plumbing versus refrigeration, machinery, or construction use."
+    if re.search(r"ACOPLE(?:S| RAPIDO)|CONECTOR RAP |BUSHING NYLON|SELLO ANTIFUGA|TAPON (?:REUSABLE|UNIVERSAL)", text):
+        return "Generic fitting; the wording lacks a named pipe/fluid system, so plumbing use cannot be established from the line alone."
+    if re.search(r"MATERIAL(?:ES)? (?:RED AGUA|DE RIEGO)|REPUESTOS MANTENCION ESTANQUE", text):
+        return "The line says materials/parts for a water-related system but does not name the actual material; proposing it would classify a job bundle, not an evidenced item."
+    if re.search(r"CARTUCHO REPUESTO FILTRO 80 MICRAS|CONTENEDOR DE FILTRO MEDIANO", text):
+        return "A fluid-filter component is named, but the wording does not identify the water, irrigation, milking, or machine system."
+    return None
+
+
+def output_row(row: dict, supplier: str, *, group: str | None = None, reason: str | None = None) -> dict:
+    result = {
+        "item_id": row["item_id"],
+        "item_text": row.get("item_text"),
+        "description": row.get("description"),
+        "supplier": supplier,
+        "amount": row.get("amount"),
+        "current_predicted_code": row.get("predicted_code"),
+    }
+    if group:
+        evidence = row.get("item_text") or row.get("description")
+        result.update({
+            "proposed_code": TARGET_CODE,
+            "proposed_categories_id": TARGET_ID,
+            "evidence": evidence,
+        })
+    else:
+        result["reason"] = reason
+    return result
+
+
+def read_existing(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
+
+
+def append_rows(path: Path, rows: list[dict]) -> None:
+    existing = read_existing(path)
+    seen = {row["item_id"] for row in existing}
+    overlap = seen & {row["item_id"] for row in rows}
+    if overlap:
+        raise SystemExit(f"refusing duplicate append to {path.name}: {len(overlap)} item_ids")
+    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        for row in rows:
+            handle.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--proposal-group")
+    parser.add_argument("--list-group")
+    parser.add_argument("--unresolved", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--list-unresolved", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--summary", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    items = [json.loads(line) for line in (BACKUP / "invoice_items.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
+    invoices = {row["invoice_id"]: row for row in map(json.loads, (BACKUP / "invoices.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())}
+    review = [row for row in items if row.get("decision") != "auto_accept" and row.get("final_categories_id") is None]
+    assert len(review) == 4411
+
+    proposed: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
+    unresolved: list[dict] = []
+    for row in review:
+        supplier = invoices[row["invoice_id"]]["seller_name"]
+        group = proposed_group(row, supplier)
+        if group:
+            proposed.setdefault(group, []).append(output_row(row, supplier, group=group))
+            continue
+        reason = unresolved_reason(row, supplier)
+        if reason:
+            unresolved.append(output_row(row, supplier, reason=reason))
+
+    proposed_ids = {row["item_id"] for rows in proposed.values() for row in rows}
+    unresolved_ids = {row["item_id"] for row in unresolved}
+    assert not proposed_ids & unresolved_ids
+
+    if args.summary:
+        for group, rows in sorted(proposed.items()):
+            print(f"proposal {group:24} {len(rows):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in rows):,}")
+        print(f"proposal TOTAL{'':18} {len(proposed_ids):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for rows in proposed.values() for row in rows):,}")
+        by_reason: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
+        for row in unresolved:
+            by_reason.setdefault(row["reason"], []).append(row)
+        for reason, rows in by_reason.items():
+            print(f"unresolved {len(rows):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in rows):,}  {reason}")
+        print(f"unresolved TOTAL {len(unresolved):4}  CLP {sum((row['amount'] or 0) for row in unresolved):,}")
+
+    if args.list_group:
+        rows = proposed.get(args.list_group)
+        if rows is None:
+            raise SystemExit(f"unknown proposal group {args.list_group!r}; choices: {sorted(proposed)}")
+        for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda row: (norm(row["item_text"]), row["item_id"])):
+            print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
+    if args.list_unresolved:
+        for row in sorted(unresolved, key=lambda row: (row["reason"], norm(row["item_text"]), row["item_id"])):
+            print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+    if args.proposal_group:
+        rows = proposed.get(args.proposal_group)
+        if rows is None:
+            raise SystemExit(f"unknown proposal group {args.proposal_group!r}; choices: {sorted(proposed)}")
+        append_rows(PROPOSAL, sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row["item_id"]))
+        print(f"appended {len(rows)} {args.proposal_group} rows to {PROPOSAL.name}")
+    if args.unresolved:
+        append_rows(UNRESOLVED, sorted(unresolved, key=lambda row: row["item_id"]))
+        print(f"appended {len(unresolved)} rows to {UNRESOLVED.name}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
